about: The review of each map's exact bytes (docs/decisions/0017-a-map-change-carries-a-review-of-its-bytes.md). tools/check-map-review.py fails any map whose sha256 is not the one recorded here.

corpus-map.json.note: Issue #95. compare.py read the map at 32c5a69 (32 entries), the bytes the legacy exemption covered, and exits 1 unless each of its 127 flags has a row in resolutions.json. The map was corrected to those rows (18 blind-right, 5 corpus-does-not-settle; 33 entries) in the same commit that replaced the exemption with this review. sha256 is the corrected map; compared.sha256 is the map before correction. The blind mapper worked from docs with every backgammon example removed (blind-mapping/REDACTIONS.md); what could not be ruled out is in blind-mapping/README.md, Limits.
